description: The opened Singapore Police Force release identifies three men allegedly participating in the 10 February assembly but does not give a full attendance count or say that only three people were present. The at-least-50 threshold is unresolved.
required_followup: Seek a contemporary source that reports total attendance; do not infer either a three-person total or attendance of at least 50 from the three identified men.

description: The police release describes the men as acting to show support for the people of Myanmar. It does not state a specific demand or identify the government or policy targeted. Neither a Singapore-directed demand nor an explicit foreign-state-only target is established.
required_followup: Review an independent contemporary account or participant statement for the exact demand and intended target before inclusion or foreign-state-only exclusion.

description: The opened police release says an investigation was ongoing. The seven coded response dimensions—accommodation, arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, ignore, killings, and shootings—remain unknown; investigation is not itself an arrest finding, and silence is not coded as absence.
required_followup: Use a source that describes the event-specific response before changing any of the seven unknown values.

description: Search-only outlets report the same three-men/police-investigation story, but no independent outlet body was opened. Repeated headlines or reports of the police account do not independently corroborate turnout, demands, or responses.
required_followup: If later authorized review opens an independent contemporary report, record its origin and determine which fields it independently supports.

description: Thirty-two native web searches preserve 639 ordered result headers, including three empty-result searches. Coverage included four disjoint February week windows, broad national protest queries, event-specific Myanmar Embassy searches, labor/migrant-worker queries, official and rights-source queries, major international publications, and targeted location/outcome checks. Open-web discovery cannot reproduce LexisNexis or local newspaper archives and does not show that no other protest occurred.
required_followup: Retain the complete capture log and use additional archive access only if available; do not interpret search-result volume as exhaustive coverage.

description: Searches used English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, and Burmese terms. Geographic targeting centered on Singapore, with embassy-related Myanmar/Yangon and Ang Mo Kio worker queries. Only an English-language official police body was read; Malay, Tamil, Chinese, and Burmese results were not independently reviewed as article bodies, and indexing/translation coverage remains limited.
required_followup: A later reviewer with language and local-archive access can verify whether other Singapore gatherings or independent descriptions were reported.

description: The January Singapore dossier was consulted read-only: its 26 January MOE assembly is a different issue and location, not a continuation of the 10 February Myanmar Embassy lead. Searches also surfaced Yangon and Myanmar-related boycott/protest leads with varying location clarity; these are not assigned to Singapore without evidence of a Singapore event. No systematic January-to-March continuity sweep was captured.
required_followup: Keep the January MOE action in its owning unit; resolve location and episode links for the Myanmar-related search-only leads before assigning them to another country-month.

description: One exact Singapore Police Force page was opened and its relevant body lines read; the web tool exposed no numeric HTTP status. The access receipts and source-specific external review are preserved. The other 16 source cards remain search_only; their snippets and titles are not used as verified event evidence. No source was marked blocked or not_found.
required_followup: Treat the saved body outcome as one official account only; no retry, alternate route, or mirror is part of this closed source phase.

description: The available MM Codebook states the project's 50-person and home-state/state-policy criteria, but the coordinator's official current baseline and reuse conditions remain pending. The supplemental Mass Mobilization Coding Procedure and LexisNexis workflow are not available in this worker dossier.
required_followup: Coordinator verifies the authoritative current baseline, universe, schema, reuse terms, and any supplemental procedure before official integration.
